headline: Amazon introduces custom reward functions for multi-turn reinforcement learning in Nova Forge.

items.title: Custom reward functions for multi-turn reinforcement learning with Amazon Nova Forge
items.summary: Amazon has released guidance on designing custom reward functions for multi-turn reinforcement learning using their Nova Forge platform. The post details how to create a composite multi-turn reward system, execute model-generated code safely, and instrument each component to mitigate potential risks. This development allows more nuanced and flexible learning protocols, enhancing model training precision and effectiveness.
items.why_it_matters: Understanding and implementing custom reward functions can significantly optimize AI model training processes and outcomes for complex tasks.

items.title: Building agentic workflows with SageMaker AI and Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Amazon's new post explains how to integrate OpenAI-compatible endpoints on SageMaker AI with Bedrock AgentCore to create multi-agent workflows. It details how each agent can leverage the best-suited model for its specific task and achieve token-level observability from SageMaker endpoints, enhancing the precision and accountability of AI systems.
items.why_it_matters: This integration simplifies the construction of complex AI workflows and improves model efficiency and transparency.

items.title: How to bring your software delivery workflow into GitHub with agent apps
items.summary: GitHub has introduced new agent apps designed to streamline software delivery workflows entirely within the GitHub environment. These apps assist in scoping, securing, rolling out, and shipping features across the software development lifecycle, thus enhancing the efficiency and security of software project management.
items.why_it_matters: Integrating these agent apps can optimize development processes and improve collaboration within the GitHub ecosystem.

all_items.title: Custom reward functions for multi-turn reinforcement learning with Amazon Nova Forge
all_items.summary: In multi-turn reinforcement learning, your custom reward function decides what the model actually learns. This post shows how to design a composite multi-turn reward for Amazon Nova Forge, execute model-generated code safely inside it, and instrument each component to catch the pitfalls that quietly collapse a reward.

all_items.title: Building agentic workflows with SageMaker AI and Bedrock AgentCore
all_items.summary: Learn how to combine OpenAI-compatible endpoints on Amazon SageMaker AI with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime to build a multi-agent workflow where each specialized agent uses the model best suited to its job. This post also shows how to get token-level observability from SageMaker endpoints that Strands Agents does not instrument by default.
